hero.title: Every document you own, finally organized itself.
hero.subtitle: DocVault reads, sorts, and understands your paperwork automatically — deadlines, payments, and important details surfaced before you even ask.

features.title: Everything your paperwork needs, in one place
features.subtitle: From the moment you upload, DocVault takes over the busywork.

item1.title: AI-powered reading & extraction
item1.description: OCR plus AI classification pulls out dates, amounts, senders, and required actions from any document automatically — no manual data entry.

item2.title: Smart calendar & reminders
item2.description: Deadlines, appointments, and payment due dates become calendar events on their own, with reminders so nothing slips through.

item3.title: Folders that keep themselves tidy
item3.description: Group documents into color-coded folders like Taxes, Finance, or Marketing, and find anything with full-text search in seconds.

item4.title: Explain, translate & ask AI
item4.description: Get a plain-language explanation of any document, translate it into 5 languages, or ask follow-up questions directly about its contents.

item5.title: Private by design
item5.description: Every document is encrypted and access-controlled per account — your files are never visible to, or used to train models for, anyone else.

item6.title: Plans that grow with you
item6.description: Start free, upgrade as your archive grows, or talk to us about an Enterprise plan for teams with custom needs.

item1.title: Never miss a deadline again
item1.description: Every due date DocVault finds becomes a reminder, automatically — before it becomes a late fee.

item2.title: Hours of filing, gone
item2.description: Stop manually renaming, sorting, and re-reading paperwork. Upload it and let DocVault do the rest.

item3.title: Understand anything instantly
item3.description: Dense contracts and official letters get a plain-language summary the moment they're uploaded.

item4.title: Your data stays yours
item4.description: Bank-level encryption and strict per-account access controls, always — nothing is ever shared.

howItWorks.title: How DocVault works
howItWorks.subtitle: From paper pile to organized archive in four steps.

step1.label: Upload or scan
step1.title: Add a document
step1.description: Drag in a PDF or photo, or scan it straight from your camera. PDFs, JPGs, PNGs, and WEBPs are all supported.

step2.label: AI reads it
step2.title: DocVault reads & understands
step2.description: OCR extracts the text, then AI classifies the document type and pulls out the details that matter.

step3.label: Review & confirm
step3.title: Check what was found
step3.description: Dates, payments, and key facts are shown for a quick review — edit anything before it's added to your calendar.

step4.label: Stay on top of it
step4.title: Get reminded automatically
step4.description: Deadlines and payments appear on your calendar with reminders, and every document stays searchable forever.
